quest.title: Lost in the Snow
quest.description: Joel asks you to ahead into the mountain to look for his father, who has yet to return from an adventure of his own...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Where has Daddy gone...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Ah, I... Hello... I—I can't find my daddy...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: He said that he would come to pick me up and that we'd go see the snow together. But the time we arranged has come and gone, and he isn't here yet...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I thought that he must have found some rare and precious treasure map or something, which is why he hasn't come to find me yet. That has to be it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: So I came to Dragonspine by myself. If he's not going to come find me, then I'll go looking for him... Or so I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: But I didn't find Daddy here, either. That Knight of Favonius over there said that he'd headed off for the mountain's summit...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I wanted to go search for him, but the Knight wouldn't let me. So I'm stuck here waiting for Daddy to come back.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: But... but he hasn't come back at all, and I'm worried.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: If you're going up Dragonspine, could you help me look for Daddy?

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Let me think... That Knight said that Daddy did mention going to follow the <color=#00E1FFFF>Snow-Covered Path upwards</color> first...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: He then said that he'd head over to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Outskirts of the Entombed City</color> to have a look, before trying for the <color=#00E1FFFF>mountain's summit</color>...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Please help me to search these areas. Daddy might still be near one of them.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: I mean, he promised that we'd go see the snow together. There's no way that he'd break his promise...

talks.objective: Follow the Snow-Covered Path to search for Joel's father

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: So far, so smooth. The weather is fine, supplies are plentiful, and the monsters have been on their best behavior...

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: I also discovered a copy of Volume 6 of "The Boar Princess" in my backpack. Joel must've sneaked it in there. That cheeky kid...

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: Still, this book is about a brave Boar Princess and her journey up a snowy mountain with her companions... Well, I'm heading up a snowy mountain myself, and considering how well everything's gone so far... Who knows? Maybe this book is bringing me good luck. Thank you, Joel.

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: Anyway, I shall be heading off to the next campsite to resupply and record my progress, and then I'll head down the mountain. Joel is waiting for me, after all.

talks.objective: Go to the western slope of the mountain to search for Joel's father

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: Nothing untoward happened on the way here. The weather remains fine indeed. It seems that my luck has turned at last.

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: Perhaps I can make a run for the summit after all...

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: I'll just give it a little go. If anything happens, I'll turn back right away.

talks.objective: Head for the summit to search for Joel's father

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: The snowstorm from the summit came too quickly. I barely had enough time to duck into this cave. I lost half my supplies in the chaos, too...

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: I don't know why, either, but the rocks above the cave collapsed suddenly, sealing the entrance with the falling gravel. This is very bad...

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: But... I believe that there's another way out for me. The other end of this cave is a cliff, yes, but there's nothing below but thick snow. If I try climbing a certain distance down and then jumping the rest of the way...

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: My supplies won't last more than a few more days. I have to act soon...

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: I promised Joel that I'd take him to see the snow. I won't break that promise.

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. If anyone sees these notes, please put some food into that feeding bowl for those foxes.

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled Note
dialogues.text: They kept me company the entire time I was trapped in here. If I get the chance, I'd love to bring Joel back here to see them...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: How did it go? Any news from Daddy?

choices.text: Here's what we discovered in the cavern at the summit...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Daddy... No, that can't be. Daddy's a great adventurer! He'd get out of a small rough patch like this for sure.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: He said that he'd found a way down the mountain in his notes, didn't he? He must've made it down safely. That's gotta be it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I suppose he made it down safely...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Exactly. He must've! He might even be resting right now.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Or... he might have set up a new campsite at the summit, and is taking a break there right now...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Whatever the case, I'm sure that once he's all rested up, Daddy will come here and look for me...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: I'll keep waiting for him here. Thanks for helping me out, by the way. Here, these are for you.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: R—Really? But that Knight of Favonius said that Daddy did go up the mountain.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Maybe he was mistaken... Or maybe Daddy set up a new campsite elsewhere...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Well, guess I'll just wait here for him... I bet Daddy would be worried sick if he came home and couldn't find me.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Thanks for helping me out. Here, take these.
